{'text': 'Apple 今日分享咗一個關於「From Earth to Sky」嘅幕後花絮，呢個時裝秀喺土耳其舉行，以 iPad Pro 設計，並用 iPhone 18 Pro Max 拍攝。以下係詳情。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple today shared a behind-the-scenes look at "From Earth to Sky," a fashion show in Turkey that was designed with an iPad Pro and filmed using an iPhone 18 Pro Max. Here are the details.'}

{'text': 'Apple 展示「From Earth to Sky」時裝秀', 'paragraph_context': "Apple showcases 'From Earth to Sky' fashion show"}

{'text': 'Apple 新聞網站不時會重點介紹旗下產品嘅有趣應用，展示公司更先進、更專業嘅硬件及軟件功能喺實際用途上嘅發揮。', 'paragraph_context': "From time to time, Apple's Newsroom highlights interesting uses of the company's products in projects that help illustrate the practical applications of their more advanced and professional hardware and software features."}

{'text': 'Apple 今日分享咗一個精彩嘅「From Earth to Sky」時裝秀花絮，呢個時裝秀由德國出生嘅設計師 Bünyamin Aydın 創作，慶祝土耳其時裝品牌 Les Benjamins 成立 15 週年。', 'paragraph_context': 'Today, Apple shared a fascinating look at "From Earth to Sky," a fashion show created by German-born designer Bünyamin Aydın to celebrate the 15th anniversary of Turkish fashion brand Les Benjamins.'}

{'text': 'Aydın 嘅創作過程主要依賴 iPad Pro 同 Apple Pencil Pro，配搭 Freeform、Procreate 等應用程式使用。', 'paragraph_context': "Aydın's creative process relies heavily on the iPad Pro and the Apple Pencil Pro, paired with apps such as Freeform and Procreate."}

{'text': 'Aydın 嘅創作過程甚少喺辦公桌前進行，所以 iPad Pro 輕薄嘅機身同長達兩日嘅電池續航力所帶來嘅靈活性令他相當受落。「佢係真正嘅流動工作站，」Aydın 話。「呢個畀咗我自由。」', 'paragraph_context': 'Aydın\'s creative process seldom takes place behind a desk, so he appreciates the flexibility iPad Pro offers with its thin, light form factor and battery life that can last him up to two days. "It\'s the ultimate workstation on the go," Aydın says. "That gives me freedom."'}

{'text': 'Aydın 話，喺呢個特定項目入面，佢用 Freeform 將相片、布料參考同早期設計整理成可同團隊分享嘅情緒板，而 Procreate 就喺設計時裝秀中三個特別訂製嘅熱氣球上擔當核心角色。', 'paragraph_context': 'For this specific project, Aydın says he used Freeform to organize photographs, fabric references, and early designs into mood boards that could be shared with his team, while Procreate played a central role in designing the three custom-built hot-air balloons featured in the show.'}

{'text': '至於新出嘅 iPhone 18 Pro Max，法國電影製作人 Neels Castillon 用佢嚟拍攝成個時裝秀，當中包括以特製無人機裝載兩部 iPhone 拍攝嘅畫面。', 'paragraph_context': 'As for where the new iPhone 18 Pro Max came in, French filmmaker Neels Castillon used the device to capture the fashion show, including footage shot with custom-built drones carrying two iPhones each.'}

{'text': '當旋轉中嘅無人機將影像傳送到 Castillon 嘅製作控制中心時，現場就即場開始同步處理。佢用配備 M4 Max 嘅 MacBook Pro 審睇片段並揀選鏡頭；佢嘅 nano-texture 顯示器有助減少頭頂陽光造成嘅眩光。', 'paragraph_context': "As feeds from the whirling drones come into Castillon's production control center, synchronizing them begins right there on location. He reviews footage and makes selections on MacBook Pro with M4 Max; its nano-texture display helps reduce glare from the sun overhead."}

{'text': '雖然呢篇報導明顯係為咗宣傳 Apple 現時產品線嘅技術能力，但同時亦帶我哋一窺一個我哋好少接觸到嘅創意世界。', 'paragraph_context': "While the post is obviously intended to help promote the technical capabilities of Apple's current product line-up, it also offers a really interesting look at a creative project from a world that very few of us have contact with."}

{'text': 'Apple 話，佢哋嘅 @apple Instagram 帳號將會由今日開始展示「From Earth to Sky」，但你亦可以喺呢度睇到幕後花絮影片、相片同更多關於呢個項目嘅詳情。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple says its @apple Instagram account will begin showcasing "From Earth to Sky" starting today, but you can also check out a behind-the-scenes video, photos, and more details about the project here.'}
